resolvedStack: React Native / Expo + Next.js 14 Web Preview + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: FitTrack Rehab Coach
description: FitTrack Rehab Coach is a mobile physical therapy companion helping patients follow daily exercise plans, log pain scores, and track mobility recovery milestones with NextAuth and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: FitTrack Rehab Coach
metadata.description: Mobile physical therapy app for rehab routines, pain logs, and recovery milestones.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react, react-icons.
Expo app configuration for FitTrack Rehab Coach.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, SessionStatus, PainLevel enums and User, RehabExercise, PainEntry, RecoveryMilestone models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for RehabExercise, PainEntry, RecoveryMilestone.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Mobile landing screen for FitTrack Rehab Coach.
Patient recovery dashboard showing daily exercise progress, pain trend, and upcoming milestones.
Daily rehab exercises checklist with completion toggles.
Pain score diary list and quick entry form.
Registration page calling POST /api/register then signing in.
Client hook fetching /api/exercises on mount via useEffect.
Client hook fetching /api/pain-logs on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for RehabExercise records.
GET and POST API route for PainEntry records.
